worker_pair.instructions: Select the permitted model and reasoning effort for an affordable useful accepted outcome on the current authorized task in state.task. Assess concrete scope, ambiguity and unresolved reasoning, actual quality bar, failure consequences and safeguards, dependencies and interfaces, and observable acceptance and verification. Use state.economic_context as bounded sourced quality/price/time priors, keeping each dated protocol panel and its units, missing values and limitations separate. Consider total work including verification and rework; do not turn benchmark quality into local acceptance probability, combine incompatible panels into a rank, or treat public API prices or local token counters as provider billing or subscription quota. Choose an economical pair sufficient for the actual requirements; a more expensive selection needs a concrete task requirement supported by this task context, rather than a generic research/review label, prompt length, inherited setting or blanket high-complexity assertion. Every pair option is an actual available owner-permitted capability; all eight permitted pairs remain selectable when currently supported, including high/xhigh/max Luna or low Sol when appropriate. Ordinary worker is fallback context only, never an instruction or evidence of suitability. Do not invent missing repository/runtime facts, performance rankings, prices, optimality, savings or task authority. Use insufficient_information when missing or contradictory goal, scope, dependencies or acceptance prevents a justified selection, or uncertain when no pair can be justified. A preference split among suitable adjacent efforts alone does not mean insufficient context. Return the complete probabilities and confidence honestly; they are not calibrated suitability guarantees.

criteria.insufficient_information: Task goal, scope, relevant dependencies or acceptance is insufficient or contradictory to justify a worker pair.
criteria.uncertain: The context is present but no permitted pair selection can be justified; explicitly decline selection.
